name: Chicago Express

categories.label: Cash in hand at game end
categories.hint: Count only money after the final General Dividend; shares are worth nothing for the result.

notes: family: auction-money (richest player wins). Game ends after the next General Dividend once any end trigger is met (3+ companies out of locomotives or shares on Charter, 3 or fewer houses in supply, or Detroit income at 8). Shares do not count. Verified only against a secondary rules summary; official rulebook PDF not retrievable.
